name: Brave Search
description: Registers the Brave Search web_search provider. openclaw 2026.7.1-2 SHIPS a complete Brave provider (dist/brave-web-search-provider-*.js, built from its own extensions/brave/src) but does NOT ship a plugin that registers it, so web_search could only ever use DuckDuckGo. This plugin is that missing registration and nothing more — it reuses openclaw's implementation rather than reimplementing the Brave API client.

contracts._doc: REQUIRED. A registerWebSearchProvider'd provider materializes ONLY if declared here, the same gate contracts.tools applies to registerTool (CLAW-082). The id must match buildBraveWebSearchProviderBase's id.

configSchema._doc: REQUIRED by openclaw: a manifest without configSchema fails config validation and `plugins install --link` refuses it with 'plugin manifest requires configSchema' (measured 2026-09-08). Mirrors the config path openclaw's own Brave provider reads, plugins.entries.brave.config.webSearch.*, per docs/tools/brave-search.md. The API KEY IS DELIBERATELY NOT SET HERE — the provider declares envVars ['BRAVE_API_KEY'] and every container already carries it, so the secret stays out of a file the agent can read. The property is declared only so a hand-set key still validates.

apiKey.description: Prefer the BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable instead.

mode.description: Brave transport: normal web results, or the LLM Context API.

baseUrl.description: Override the Brave API base URL (proxy or compatible gateway).
